option.name: -b
tip: Enable the 64bit feature and move metadata as needed.

option.name: -f
tip: Force the resize, overriding safety checks.

option.name: -F
tip: Flush the device buffer caches before starting.

option.name: -M
tip: Shrink the file system to its minimum size.

option.name: -p
tip: Print percentage completion bars for each phase.

option.name: -P
tip: Print the minimum size the file system would shrink to.

option.name: -s
tip: Disable the 64bit feature and free unused blocks.

option.name: -S
tip: Set the RAID stride instead of detecting it heuristically.

option.name: -z
tip: Write the old contents of each block to an undo file.
